title: T‑Mobile Helps New York City Stay Connected Through Its Biggest Moments
summary: As the city prepares for its Thanksgiving Day parade amid forecasts of rain and strong winds, T‑Mobile continues working alongside public safety partners to support connectivity and readiness
body_markdown:
From major sporting events and citywide celebrations to parades and festivals, New York City has had no shortage of big moments in 2026. At many of these events, T‑Mobile has worked behind the scenes alongside city and public safety partners to help support connectivity for residents, visitors and first responders.


That work continues as New York City prepares for its 100th Thanksgiving Day parade on November 26.


> “At T‑Mobile, we’re deeply committed to supporting the public safety mission. We know the incredible amount of planning and coordination it takes for first responders and city crews to keep events like New York City’s Thanksgiving Day parade running safely,” said Chris Sambar, Chief Enterprise Officer, T‑Mobile Business Group. “We’re proud to work alongside the city’s public safety teams throughout the year, using our network capabilities, including T-Priority, to help them stay connected and serve the community.”


In coordination with the New York Police Department (NYPD), T‑Mobile has deployed a temporary mobile cell site in Manhattan as an added layer of connectivity support for public safety operations. With stormy conditions in the forecast, we’ll also closely monitor weather and network conditions, coordinate with city and public safety partners and have on-site support ready to make adjustments as needed.


T‑Mobile’s[T-Priority](https://tmobile-newsroom.wistia.com/medias/z0rhuqldik) helps keep critical communications moving by giving eligible first responders priority access to network resources, even when large crowds put heavy demand on the network. During the parade,[T-Priority](https://www.t-mobile.com/t-priority) will support connectivity for NYPD, city sanitation crews and other city and emergency management partners coordinating operations around the celebration.


T-Priority in action


### **Supporting NYC All Year Long**


The Thanksgiving parade is just one of the many major events T‑Mobile has helped prepare for this year.


Throughout 2026, we have coordinated with city partners around major events, including the international soccer tournament, Fourth of July celebrations, the city’s marathon and other large public gatherings.


That support has included additional network capacity, real-time monitoring and on-site support in close coordination with public safety agencies. T-Priority has also helped support NYPD operations at several major events throughout the year.


Each event brings different needs, but the approach remains the same: plan ahead, coordinate closely with public safety partners and be ready to respond as conditions change.


### **Looking Ahead to the Holidays**


With the city’s annual holiday tree lighting and New Year’s Eve celebrations still ahead, T‑Mobile’s network readiness work continues. We remain focused on planning ahead, coordinating with city partners and preparing for the connectivity needs that come with some of New York’s busiest moments.


For more information on T‑Mobile’s preparedness and response capabilities, visit the company’s[Emergency Response hub](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/emergency-response) and follow @TMobileNews on X and Instagram.
